messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert P-48921 triggered for service "hosted-inference" — elevated 5xx (503) rate on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Severity: high. Primary paged: Maya (oncall). Escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> manager. Link: https://pagerduty.example/P-48921

incident-bot: Primary did not acknowledge within 90s; auto-escalating to secondary: Sam (secondary).

Sam (secondary): ugh i'm in DND, phone didn't ring. can't ack via mobile. @Maya if you're awake can you take, else i'll try to reach jordan

incident-bot: Escalated to manager: Jordan (manager).

Jordan (manager): Acked. I'm awake, taking incident. :eyes: What's the impact? any customer-facing errors or degraded throughput?

Maya (oncall): sorry, on a call. just saw notifications. acking now but if Jordan already took it i'm happy to hand off. :wave:

Ava (SRE): quick snapshot from logs — spiky 503s from inference-prod pods, seems correlated with a sudden tokenization latency bump. sample log:

``
[2026-03-15T02:14:22Z] req_id=abc123 svc=hosted-inference path=/v1/generate status=503 latency_ms=1205 error="model-kv-cache-timeout"
[2026-03-15T02:14:23Z] req_id=def456 svc=hosted-inference path=/v1/generate status=503 latency_ms=1400 error="kv-lookup-failed"
``

Ava (SRE): quick checks I ran:
- `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://hosted.example/v1/generate` => multiple 503s
- `kubectl get pods -n prod | grep inference-prod` shows 3/6 pods Ready and 5 restarts on two replicas

Ava (SRE): suggested mitigation from runbook: scale inference-prod, rotate a subset onto dedicated pool, and enable circuit-breaker to reduce retry storms. commands:

``
kubectl scale deployment inference-prod -n prod --replicas=12
# move traffic: run internal playbook to shift 30% to dedicated-pool
playbook shift-traffic --service hosted-inference --dest dedicated-pool --percent 30
``

Jordan (manager): Do it. Jordan acked the PD incident at 6790001280.

Maya (oncall): I'll coordinate the roll and stay with postmortem notes. passing lead to Jordan for now.

Ava (SRE): Ran scale, here's the output:
``
deployment.apps/inference-prod scaled
# after 60s
kubectl get pods -n prod | grep inference-prod
inference-prod-abcde	1/1	Running	0	20s
inference-prod-fghij	1/1	Running	0	18s
... (total 12 pods)
``

Ava (SRE): error rate dropping — last 1m 5xx rate 1.2% (was 6.5%). still watching. :thumbsup:

Jordan (manager): Good work. keep me posted if it re-spikes. we'll file a follow-up and add a runbook tweak (PD escalation timeout shorter, and verify mobile routing for secondaries).

incident-bot: Incident P-48921 acknowledged by Jordan at 6790001280. Current status: mitigated (scaling + traffic shift). Please continue monitoring and file postmortem if regression > 1% for > 10m.

Maya (oncall): noted. I'll draft incident notes and assign postmortem owner.

Sam (secondary): sorry for the DND mess — will review mobile settings and PD device rules.

Ava (SRE): adding logs to the incident. next steps: eval quantization path that caused KV timeouts and schedule model rollback test.

Jordan (manager): closing on-call handoff — thanks all.
